capacity: Forty seated nave places, a small choir and bounded parish work; normal-use seats do not create forty search rooms.

staging.note: Use actual canonical van, ground support and parish gate clearance; no substitute vehicle geometry.

terrain_cutouts.method: Persisted editor AdaptiveTerrainTopology punching below the entire crypt including sealed vaults and stair. Architectural ceilings/foundation cover and floor voids remain separate construction requirements.

structural_interfaces.requirement: Only rear choir has a deck. Nave/chancel remain tall, open volumes; build supported beam/pier load paths, guard and full flight opening.
Tower masonry piers pass to ground foundations; bell load attaches to real braced frame, not floating roof props.

decisions: Retain the distinctive parish footprint, nave/chancel, side chapel, choir at+3, belfry at+6 and crypt at-3, while replacing unsupported use of leftover room collections.
Move crypt flight to an east ground bay beneath music service; keep forty actual-sized nave seat reservations and clear centre/side aisles.
Parish meetings, confidential records and discreet sanitary room are bounded; vestry preparation, washing and dry vestments are separate.
Keep choir/tower thresholds beyond guard ends. Full physical upper-wall holes, supports and optical/player passage remain required.
Keep the memorial crypt playable while four larger burial vaults remain permanently sealed context, without tasks or ghost anchors inside.
remaining: Author/inspect actual altar, choir, organ-maintenance, bell frame, masonry/roof beams, seating, support and source materials.
Construct permanent vault barriers, actual runtime sockets and shared native ownership inside the accessible envelope.
Punch saved world terrain below the complete crypt, with actual roof/ground cover and architectural stair openings; prove body/optical/object/render holes using filled-ground negatives.
Verify grounded parish arrival, stairs, closed/open doors, ghost/hunter routes, rituals, electrical operation, native/runtime/network parity and required performance; no round-time testing.

search_envelope.count_rule: Every OPEN_SEARCH space counts, including corridors, stairs, service rooms, exterior sectors and staging. Stable fifteen gameplay owners are not the room budget.

barriers.requirement: Permanent body/object/ghost/interaction boundary; rendering and optical response must match solid leaf/infill or intended glazing. No player key, power state, event or damaged leaf may reopen it. Author and verify native/runtime collision; annotation alone is not a seal.

search_envelope.gameplay_rule: Evidence, ghost spawn/anchor, hiding, switches/tasks, ritual sites, loose objective props and required travel belong only to the connected open envelope. Context windows may show rooms, but no interaction or required search crosses the seal.
search_envelope.context_rule: Retain coherent historical rooms/assets behind permanent boundaries. Restrict whole wings to their hallways where useful; do not count shuttable ordinary doors as permanent seals.
search_envelope.next_gate: Build actual permanent seals and audit runtime player/ghost/object/optical boundaries and all objective placements; construct the maps inside the forty-space cap. Round-duration testing is outside this rebuild task.
